args.sql_query:
WITH first_30_days AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date
    FROM calendar
    ORDER BY date
    LIMIT 30
),
unavailable_all_30 AS (
    SELECT listing_id
    FROM calendar
    WHERE date IN (SELECT date FROM first_30_days)
      AND available = false
    GROUP BY listing_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_30_days)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS listings_unavailable_all_30_days
FROM unavailable_all_30
args.name: Listings unavailable on all first 30 days

suggestions: What percentage of total listings does that represent?

details.reference_sql:
WITH start AS (SELECT MIN(date) AS d FROM calendar)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS listings_fully_unavailable
FROM (
  SELECT c.listing_id
  FROM calendar c, start s
  WHERE c.date >= s.d AND c.date < s.d + 30
  GROUP BY c.listing_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.available) = 30
) t

    l.room_type,
    ROUND(AVG(review_count), 2) AS avg_reviews_last_12_months
